name: Sun Cleric: Stand Against Darkness's helper stays permanent (#9519)
contract: Talent 707078 applies helper 707768 through AscensionSunCleric.cpp's Refresh (every 500 ms via OnPlayerUpdate) whenever it is daytime and 707078 is known. Unlike the other day/health-gated helper pairs in the same loop (e.g. Pure Light 300314/301341), 707768 was only ever re-applied with SetHelper, which leaves its native 15000 ms DBC duration in place and keeps resetting it to a fresh countdown every refresh tick instead of making it permanent. Refresh now calls KeepHelper for 707768, matching the sibling pairs: once applied, its duration is forced to -1 (permanent) and stays -1 across further refresh ticks. The default accelerated gameplay clock anchors realm-local time at hour 10, inside Daytime()'s 06:00-18:00 window, so the talent's day gate is satisfied deterministically for the short window this scenario runs.

steps.label: Let login and level scaling settle
The helper is permanent, not a countdown
Let several more refresh ticks run
The helper stays permanent across refresh ticks
Unlearning the talent removes the helper
